propositions: Test plants a young index.lock and arms threading.Timer(0.4) to delete it, but timer cannot distinguish planted lock from git's own real lock created during git commit.
On slow runners, git commit still holds its real index.lock when timer fires at t=0.4, causing timer to delete git's lock mid-commit, resulting in 'fatal: unable to write new index file' error.
Test must replace wall-clock threading.Timer with gitutil._retry_probe deterministic release mechanism to fire only after confirmed retry attempt, not by elapsed time.

Production code in _git_add/_git_commit passes force_reclaim=True, causing planted young lock to be reclaimed on first retry attempt, so real backoff path is correct and test-only race condition is isolated.
